input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build, so the preferred position is met. The only "shall not" covenants binding us are internal-to-the-license scope limits: the Field of Use definition (p0007) and the Additional Restrictions in Article II (p0035, p0040–p0047) limit how we may use Licensor's own Licensed Technology (no use outside scope, no sublicensing/distribution, no Derivative Works, no reverse engineering), and Article VI (p0085) restricts sub-licensing the Licensed Technology. These govern use of the Vendor's IP rather than restraining our own trading or platform business, and nothing prevents us from licensing, building or operating another FX platform. Article X is a non-solicitation of Licensor employees only (p0125), not a non-compete. Noted but not flagged here: the Change of Control provision (p0134) lets Licensor deem consent reasonably withheld where an acquirer conducts a competitive business, and the Article XXII right of first refusal (p0139) — these are exit/assignment constraints properly addressed under the change-of-control and assignment rules, not restrictions on the businesses we may operate.
